Name: Wetland Cultivation
Author: QiuFengTanoka
Description:
(My native language is not English, so there may be errors. I'm sorry.)

Enable crops to obtain water from surrounding water sources without the need for watering around the water source.
Keep farmland within 4 grids in eight directions of the water source moist,
This is a very reasonable adjustment, and I don't think it will particularly affect the balance of the game.
After excavation, it will not immediately become damp. During the first excavation, you still need to water, but the farmland will remain moist thereafter.

使作物能够从周围的水源中获得水，从而无需在水源周围浇水。
让在水源八个方向4格以内的耕地保持湿润，
这是一个非常合理的调整，我不认为它会特别影响游戏的平衡。
挖掘后，它不会立即受潮。第一次挖掘时，您仍然需要浇水，但此后农田将保持湿润。
